svg.aria-label: Owns the model: Owns organisations, roles and entitlements for every synthwerk service. Login by Zitadel v4: OIDC, passkeys, MFA. No login form lives here. Stripe in, entitlements out: Turns Stripe events into one entitlements table. The paywall reads that table. Identity events: Emits identity events on the NATS bus. The other services trust them
